desc: Take home the Google Pixel 10 with your choice of our pay monthly phone contracts and SIM free deals. This handset keeps everything people loved about the Pixel 9 and pushes it further with upgrades in performance, photography, and display technology. Immerse yourself in a 6.3-inch Actua display, boasting a sharp, Full HD+ (1080 x 2424) OLED resolution. Offering Smooth Display technology (60-120Hz), the Pixel 10 will adapt how often it refreshes, ensuring fluid movement when you’re gaming or streaming, and reduced battery use for low-energy tasks like reading text and looking at photos. Another revision has seen Google squeeze in a 10.8MP 5x telephoto lens (supporting up to 20x Super Res Zoom) and slim down the ultrawide to 13MP, allowing for clearer zooms and brighter landscapes. The Pixel 10 introduces Google’s most powerful chipset to date – the Tensor G5. Alongside making the phone more responsive, it launches with Android 16, and it runs the latest Gemini Nano model (and runs it more efficiently), including new offline AI skills. This chipset also enables new and upgraded Gemini AI features like Magic Cue, Pixel Screenshots and Camera Coach. Another significant upgrade is in the battery size, at 4,970mAh compared to 4,700mAh in the Pixel 9. According to Google it should last you over 24 hours on full charge, but still allows for fast wired charging (up to 55% in ~30 minutes with a 30W charger), while new PixelSnap Qi2 magnetic wireless charging supports up to 15W. With two capacities to choose from (128GB and 256GB) and 12GB RAM, you’ll find the Google Pixel 10 in an array of colours, including Frost, Indigo, Lemongrass and Obsidian.

Thanks to a flagship-worthy 120Hz refresh rate and 2640 x 1080 resolution, you’re treated to a crisp, responsive viewing experience as you move from screen to screen. You don’t need to worry about doing any damage to your phone as you flip open your screen, either. You’ll also find two pro-grade rear cameras, including a leading 50MP wide and 12MP ultra wide rear lens, and a 10MP front camera lens for capturing the perfect selfie on your first try. Snapping after dark? No problem. Nightography detects and adjusts to shooting in low light, so you can capture beautifully rich details even in the dead of night. Extensive personalisation features in Galaxy AI and the One UI 8 interface mean the Flip7 FE feels more like your own than ever before. Redesigned to suit Samsung’s flip and fold series, One UI 8 lets you try a huge range of widgets on both the Flex Window and main screen. Seamless AI integration is there to help you create personalised, animated wallpapers, select the widgets you reach for most on your cover screen, and deliver notifications smartly and smoothly. If you’re looking for a flip phone that’s as smart as it is sturdy, this is the one for you.

name: Apple iPhone 16e 128GB Black
desc: The Apple iPhone 16e takes everything you love about the SE series and brings it into the modern era. Available to buy alongside a pay monthly contract or SIM-free, the iPhone 16e combines premium features with an affordable price point, and is packed with major upgrades over the iPhone SE 3 (2022), offering a more powerful, stylish and feature-heavy experience. With a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display, the iPhone 16e is a huge step up from the 4.7-inch LCD on the iPhone SE 3. Playing games, watching videos, and even carrying out simple everyday emails feel effortless and immersive, made brighter and sharper still with the spectacular 1,200 nits peak brightness available. Under the hood, the A18 Bionic chip with 4-core GPU delivers blazing-fast performance, for smoother multitasking and seamless AI-powered features; like other family members in the iPhone 16 series, the iPhone 16e is built with Apple Intelligence, operating on iOS 18. The 48MP main camera is a huge jump from the 12MP sensor on the iPhone SE 3, capturing stunningly detailed shots. Apple Intelligence comes into its own here, too, with shooting capabilities including True Tone flash, Deep Fusion and Night Mode taking your snaps up a notch, even before you get to the impressive editing suite. Practical and pocket-sized, the iPhone 16e’s aluminium design measures in at 146.7 x 71.5 x 7.8 mm, and is shielded with durable glass back and Ceramic Shield front. The handset is further protected by IP68 water resistance, which can withstand dust, splashes and water, so you’ll get away scot-free if your phone takes an accidental dip while you’re washing up. Additional features such as dual SIM and e-SIM compatibility take the iPhone 16e to the next level whether you’re travelling or switching between work and personal calls You don’t need to worry about running out of charge, either; the powerful battery provides up to 26 hours of video playback and fast-charge capabilities.
